name: tdd-bug-hunter
description: Adversarial TDD loop: write failing test → fix → verify → repeat until dry

agents.prompt: Find one untested bug in {{target}}. Return: file, line, description, minimal repro.
Write a failing test for this bug: {{bug}}. Use the project's test framework.
Fix the bug exposed by this test: {{test}}. Minimal change only.
Run the tests and verify the fix. Confirm green. If not, report what failed.

loop.exit_condition: 2 consecutive rounds with no new bugs found
